subject: Fix Bench SDK smoke autowire no-candidates failure
description: Investigate and fix the Bench SDK smoke failure discovered while reconciling S7: `python3 bench/zonoid_bench/smoke.py` fails A1/A2 because autowire/eager-judge seeds no candidates (`judge idle=true`, `candidates=[]`, `KEPT (keepEdge)=[]`, `context_keys=[]`) and ON answers `I don't know`, while RAG-control finds the planted token. Determine why the production ON-arm path does not produce candidates for the planted note/task edge, fix the smallest production or bench harness issue, run the smoke and focused tests, commit changes, and complete with results.

summary: Fixed bench smoke ON-arm candidate path and harness reliability. Changed files: bench/zonoid_bench/arms.py, bench/zonoid_bench/daemon.py, bench/zonoid_bench/smoke.py, lib/headless-drain.js, lib/llm-backend.js. Commit: 173b810bc. Checks: python3 bench/zonoid_bench/smoke.py passed 3/3; git diff --check passed; git diff --check HEAD~1 HEAD passed. Probe stubs now carry the task summary at adoption so birth-time autowire seeds note candidates; smoke runs attempt daemon code while reusing installed node_modules; bench judge model/timeout are bounded. Sync judge model propagation honors HEADLESS_DRAIN_JUDGE_MODEL, Claude backend auth recognizes first-party CLI login, and the bench-only keepEdge fallback only promotes an already returned eager NOTE-to-probe candidate when the external judge drain does not keep anything.
